basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old digital marketer from Boise, Idaho, with a knack for online trading and gaming. I spend my evenings and weekends on Reddit, mainly trading Rocket League items and engaging with the local scene. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to game and explore new strategies on r/Baystreetbets. My interests include gaming, digital marketing, and exploring new tech trends. I'm not much into reading lengthy posts, but I do enjoy a good meme or two. I usually browse Reddit late at night, post-work. A big fan of the Boise State Broncos and enjoy catching their games when I'm not trading or gaming.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Gained expertise in digital marketing through a combination of formal education and real-world experience. Self-taught in trading and gaming strategies, mainly through online forums and communities. Recently started diving into investment strategies, inspired by discussions on r/Baystreetbets.
